$Z_{1}(j\omega)=R^{\prime}+jX=\frac{Z_{C}·Z_{L}}{Z_{C}+Z_{L}}$=
=$\frac{\left( -j \frac{1}{\omega c}+R_{2} \right)·(j\omega L+R_{L})}{\left( -j \frac{1}{\omega c}+R_{2} \right)+(j\omega L+R_{L})}$=
=$\frac{\frac{L}{C}-j \frac{R_{L}}{\omega C}+j\omega R_{2}L+R_{2}R_{L}}{R_{2}+R_{L}}$=
=$\frac{\overbrace{ R_{2}+R_{L}+\frac{L}{C} }^{ R_{A} }+j\overbrace{ \left( \omega R_{2}L-\frac{R_{L}}{\omega C} \right) }^{ X_{A} }}{\underbrace{ R_{2}+R_{L} }_{ R_{B} }+j\underbrace{ \left( \omega L-\frac{1}{\omega C} \right) }_{ X_{B} }}$=
=$\frac{R_{A}+jX_{A}}{R_{B}+jX_{B}}·\frac{R_{A}-jX_{A}}{R_{B}-jX_{B}}$=
=$\frac{R_{A}R_{B}-jX_{B}R_{A}+jX_{A}R_{B}+X_{A}+X_{B}}{R_{B}^{2}+X_{B}^{2}}$=
=$\frac{R_{A}R_{B}+X_{A}X_{B}+j(X_{A}R_{B}-X_{B}R_{A})}{R_{B}^{2}+X_{B}^{2}}$=

=$R^{\prime}+jX$
$X=\frac{X_{A}R_{B}-X_{B}R_{A}}{\underbrace{ R_{B}^{2}+X_{B}^{2} }_{ \geq 0 }}=0$
$X_{A}R_{B}-X_{B}R_{A}=0$
$X_{A}R_{B}=X_{B}R_{A}$
$\left( \omega R_{2}L-\frac{R_{L}}{\omega C} \right)·(R_{2}+R_{L})=\left( \omega L-\frac{1}{\omega C} \right)·\left( R_{2}R_{L}+\frac{L}{C} \right) /·\omega C$
$(\omega^{2}R_{2}LC-R_{L})·(R_{2}+RL)=(\omega^{2}LC-1)·\left( R_{2}+R_{L}+\frac{L}{C} \right)$
$\omega^{2}(R_{2}+R_{L})R_{2}LC-R_{L}(R_{2}+R_{L})=\omega^{2}\left( R_{2}R_{L}+\frac{L}{C} \right)LC-\left( R_{2}R_{L}+\frac{L}{C} \right)$
$\omega^{2}(R_{2}+R_{L})R_{2}LC-\omega^{2}\left( R_{2}R_{L}+\frac{L}{C} \right)LC=R_{L}(R_{2}+R_{L})-R_{2}R_{L}-\frac{L}{C}$
$\omega_{0}=\sqrt{ \frac{R_{L}(R_{2}+R_{L})-R_{2}R_{L}-\frac{L}{C}}{(R_{2}+R_{L})R_{2}LC-\left( R_{2}R_{L}+\frac{L}{C} \right)LC} }=2\pi f_{0}$

$\omega L=6Ω$
$R=4Ω$
$\frac{1}{\omega C}=8Ω$

$U_{RMS}=I_{CRMS}·\frac{1}{\omega C}=6A·8Ω=48V$
$U_{C}(j\omega)=I_{C}(j\omega)·Z_{C}(j\omega)$
$(U_{RMS})e^{ j\varphi_{U}}=I_{CRMS}·e^{ j\varphi_{I} }·\frac{1}{\omega C}e^{j-90°}$
$I_{RMS}=\frac{U_{RMS}}{R}=\frac{48V}{4Ω}=12A_{RMS}$

$U_{2}(j\omega)=U_{1}(j\omega) \frac{Z(j\omega)}{R_{1}+Z(j\omega)}$
$K(j\omega)=\frac{U_{2}(j\omega)}{U_{1}(j\omega)}=\frac{Z}{R_{1}+Z}$=
=$\frac{Z_{L}+R_{L}}{R_{1}+Z_{L}+R_{L}}$=
=$\frac{j\omega L+R_{L}}{R_{1}+j\omega L+R_{L}}$=
=$\frac{R_{L}+j\omega L}{R_{1}+R_{L}+j\omega L}$

$|K(j\omega)|=k(\omega)=\frac{U_{2RMS}}{U_{1RMS}}=\frac{|R_{L}+j\omega L|}{|R_{1}+R_{2}+j\omega L|}=\frac{\sqrt{ R_{L}^{2}+(\omega L)^{2} }}{\sqrt{ (R_{1}+R_{L})^{2}+(\omega L)^{2} }}$
$\frac{100Ω}{1100Ω}=0.091$
